clause: Eraser family: general, background, magic/flood, undo brush [STU-RAS-028]

scope.summary: Implement the deduped eraser family: general eraser (erase to transparency or background color, in brush/pencil/block modes, and erase-to-history-state); background eraser (erase sampled background color to transparency while protecting a foreground color, with sampling modes and tolerance); magic/flood eraser (erase all similar-colored pixels to transparency in one action, by tolerance/contiguity); and undo brush (paint areas back to an earlier history/snapshot state). Where a source suite routes erasing on a non-destructive placed-asset layer through masking, prefer the masking route by default.
acceptance_criteria: placed-asset erase defaults to masking, not destruction
proof_targets: eraser family runtime + placed-asset masking-route test
expected_tests: live: general eraser erases to transparency; background eraser removes sampled bg while protecting a fg color; magic eraser clears similar pixels by tolerance
test: erasing on a placed_asset routes through masking by default (no pixel destruction)

target_entries: Studio / Raster / Erasers & the undo brush

risk_if_missed: No erasers; and placed-asset edits destroy pixels instead of masking (non-destructive violation).

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
